mistakes.text: He tipped the barrel into a cleanest river in the valley.
mistakes.normalized: he tipped the barrel into a cleanest river in the valley
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred superlatívom patrí „the“, nie „a“ – taká rieka je len jedna: „the cleanest river“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před superlativem patří „the“, ne „a“ – taková řeka je jen jedna: „the cleanest river“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A superlative takes “the”, never “a”, because there is only one: “the cleanest river”.

mistakes.text: He emptied the barrel into a cleanest river in the valley.
mistakes.normalized: he emptied the barrel into a cleanest river in the valley
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred superlatívom patrí „the“, nie „a“ – taká rieka je len jedna: „the cleanest river“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před superlativem patří „the“, ne „a“ – taková řeka je jen jedna: „the cleanest river“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A superlative takes “the”, never “a”, because there is only one: “the cleanest river”.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Superlatív potrebuje člen „the“: „into the cleanest river“.

mistakes.text: He tipped the barrel into that cleanest river in the valley.
mistakes.normalized: he tipped the barrel into that cleanest river in the valley
mistakes.feedback_sk: Slovenské „tej“ tu len zdôrazňuje; pred superlatívom patrí v angličtine „the“, nie „that“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: České „té“ tu jen zdůrazňuje; před superlativem patří v angličtině „the“, ne „that“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Before a superlative English uses “the”, not “that”: “the cleanest river”.

mistakes.feedback_en: Before a superlative English uses “the”, not “that”: “the cleanest river”.

mistakes.text: He tipped the barrel into the cleanest river in valley.
mistakes.normalized: he tipped the barrel into the cleanest river in valley
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba člen: „in the valley“ – ide o konkrétne údolie.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí člen: „in the valley“ – jde o konkrétní údolí.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Valley” needs an article because it is a specific valley: “in the valley”.

mistakes.text: He emptied the barrel into the cleanest river in valley.

mistakes.feedback_en: “Valley” needs an article because it is a specific valley: “in the valley”.

mistakes.text: He tipped the barrel into the most clean river in the valley.
mistakes.normalized: he tipped the barrel into the most clean river in the valley
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Clean“ je krátke prídavné meno, superlatív tvorí príponou: „the cleanest“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Clean“ je krátké přídavné jméno, superlativ tvoří příponou: „the cleanest“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Clean” is a short adjective, so its superlative is “the cleanest”, not “the most clean”.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri superlatíve s miestom je prirodzenejšie „in“: „the cleanest river in the valley“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U superlativu s místem je přirozenější „in“: „the cleanest river in the valley“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After a superlative, places normally take “in”: “the cleanest river in the valley”.
